questions.question_text: Which of the following is correct about adding numbers greater than 100,000?
questions.question_text_en: Which of the following is correct about adding numbers greater than 100,000?
choices: Write digits aligned by place value
You can add without aligning place values
The sum must be greater than any addend
questions.correct_answer: Write digits aligned by place value
questions.answer: Write digits aligned by place value
questions.explanation: Always align digits by place value when adding multi-digit numbers
